testimonials.title: Real experiences. Meaningful progress.
testimonials.description: Every recovery journey is different. These experiences reflect the value of understanding the person, building trust, and progressing with a clear clinical direction.

sarah.name: Sarah M.
sarah.quote: The first time a physiotherapist listened to every single habit in my day and running routine before touching my knee. Understanding was what made all the difference.

tarek.name: Tarek M.
tarek.quote: I thought surgery was inevitable. Dr. Mohamed explained the biomechanics and made me an active partner until I completely regained my arm mobility.

mahmoud.name: Mahmoud H.
mahmoud.quote: My recovery journey from a lumbar disc issue without perpetual painkillers — how Dr. Mohamed taught me to manage my daily movement.

karim.name: Karim A.
karim.quote: Dr. Mohamed restored my trust in every jump and stride on the pitch through rigorous objective testing.

nadia.name: Dr. Nadia F.
nadia.quote: The serenity of the space and singular focus during sessions is rare. Dr. Mohamed practices with the highest clinical and ethical rigor.

omar.name: Omar Sh.
omar.quote: Overuse wrist and elbow rehabilitation — progressing from complete rest back to peak athletic output.
